baseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible URL
baseUrl.description: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL or /chat/completions endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:8045/v1 or https://api.openai.com/v1).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name sent in the chat completions request.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Bearer token sent when no keychain secret is configured below. Clear this field if your server does not require authentication.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP timeout bounded to OpenIDEA's 60s task budget (5 to 58 seconds).
